name: diffmute
description: Collapse or hide noisy files on GitHub pull request diffs.

scripts.sign: node scripts/build.mjs --stamp && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js sign --channel unlisted
scripts.install:firefox: npm run sign && open -a Firefox "$(ls -t web-ext-artifacts/*.xpi | head -1)"
